_source: Live capture 2026-07-22 from IM Sports (Sunflower 2.0) GetSE endpoint.
_notes: Basketball is SportId 2 (NOT 54 — that was a different highlights category).
bti 1 = 让分 (point spread / handicap): si 1 = home, si 2 = away. Line in hdp / dih.
bti 2 = 大/小 (over/under total): si 3 = over (大), si 4 = under (小). Line in hdp / dih.
bti 4 = 独赢 (moneyline, 2-way, no draw): si 8 = home, si 9 = away. No line.
Odds per selection via ot: ot 3 = European decimal (decimal=o, HK display=o-1); ot 2 = Hong Kong (display=o, decimal=o+1). 让分/大小 use ot 2; 独赢 uses ot 3.

MULTIPLE LINES: 让分/大小 offer several lines simultaneously as separate mls entries distinguished by ml (ml 1 = main line, 2+ = alternates). This fixture keeps only ml:1. The draft selection_key (eid:period:type:name) has no line component, so exposing only the main line avoids selection_key collisions; alternate lines need a selection_key redesign to support.
